_meta.author: Expert hand-curated classification of all 400 MC types in the CustomNPC-Plus codebase
_meta.purpose: Authoritative migration mapping. Tells the toolchain exactly what to do with each MC type encountered in core/ code.

categories.EXISTING: Already abstracted and registered in migration tooling. Symbol-Swap ready.
categories.INTERFACE: Needs a PA interface (or PA interface exists but not yet registered). These appear as types in method signatures, fields, and locals in core/ code.
categories.SERVICE: Static utility/singleton. Methods route to PlatformService or NBTIO. Cannot be interfaces (Java 7 has no static interface methods).
categories.TRANSFORM: Handled by Static-Transform regex. Annotations, enums, or math utilities that get textually replaced.
categories.SUPPRESS: Never abstract. Client-only, networking, entity hierarchy, event system, or too niche. Code using these stays in mc1710.

types.__comment_existing: === EXISTING: Already abstracted, Symbol-Swap ready (11 types) ===

NBTTagCompound.notes: Most-imported MC type. 4,447 method calls. Core NBT compound wrapper.

EntityPlayer.notes: Core player abstraction. 180 casts, 122 instanceof across codebase.

EntityPlayerMP.notes: Server-side player. Maps to same IPlayer as EntityPlayer.

Entity.notes: Base entity type. Used heavily in casts and instanceof.

ItemStack.notes: Item stack wrapper. NOTE: 1.11+ changes null → ItemStack.EMPTY.

EntityLivingBase.notes: Living entity base. 1,113 field accesses across codebase.

World.notes: World access. Used for block/entity queries, spawning, etc.

WorldServer.notes: Server world. Maps to same IWorld as World.

types.__comment_interface: === INTERFACE: Need PA interface for core/ migration (15 types) ===

ResourceLocation.reason: Universal asset/registry identifier. Exists in all MC versions with same semantics. Pure value object — 2 getters + toString. Factory methods go to PlatformService since Java 7 can't have static interface methods.
ResourceLocation.notes: Simple to abstract. Low risk. High impact (145 imports).

AxisAlignedBB.reason: Bounding box geometry. Used in collision detection, targeting, area queries. Same concept across all versions but package changes.
AxisAlignedBB.notes: Mostly used in entity/ability code that stays in mc1710. Only abstract if core code needs it.

ICommandSender.reason: Command execution context. Used in command system which migrates to core. 1.13+ replaces with CommandSource (Brigadier).
ICommandSender.notes: Name stays ICommandSender — already good. Will need Brigadier adapter in 1.13+ leaves.

Vec3.reason: 3D vector. Used in abilities, AI targeting, raytrace. Same concept in all versions.
Vec3.notes: Consider making immutable value object with static factory.

ChatComponentText.reason: Chat text. 1.7: ChatComponentText, 1.16: StringTextComponent, 1.19: Component.literal(). The PA name ITextComponent is stable across all versions.
ChatComponentText.notes: ChatComponentText, ChatComponentTranslation, and IChatComponent all map to ITextComponent. Factory methods on PlatformService: createTextComponent(String), createTranslation(String key, Object... args).

ChatComponentTranslation.reason: Translatable chat text. Maps to same ITextComponent. Factory: PlatformService.createTranslation(key, args).

IChatComponent.reason: Chat component interface. All chat types map to ITextComponent.
IChatComponent.notes: This IS the base interface in 1.7.10. In modern MC it's Component.

ChatStyle.reason: Text formatting style. Paired with ITextComponent.
ChatStyle.notes: Low import count but semantically necessary for complete text abstraction.

MovingObjectPosition.reason: Raytrace result. 1.7: MovingObjectPosition, 1.9+: RayTraceResult, 1.16+: HitResult. Used in abilities and targeting.
MovingObjectPosition.notes: Inner enum MovingObjectType also needs mapping (BLOCK, ENTITY, MISS).

NBTBase.reason: Base NBT tag type. Used when working with heterogeneous NBT tag collections (e.g., iterating NBTTagList contents).
NBTBase.notes: Minimal interface. Most code already uses INbt/INbtList directly.

Potion.reason: Potion type registry entry. 1.7: Potion[] array, 1.9+: Registry<Potion>. Used in custom effects system.
Potion.notes: Registration changes significantly between versions. Core uses id-based lookup.

PotionEffect.reason: Active potion effect instance. Used in custom effects, ability system.
PotionEffect.notes: 1.9+ changes getPotionID() to getPotion() returning registry entry.

Explosion.reason: Explosion event data. Used in ability system for energy explosions.
Explosion.notes: Low import count. Consider if SERVICE would be simpler.

Configuration.reason: Forge configuration file wrapper. Config system migrates to core. 1.13+ uses TOML-based ForgeConfigSpec instead.
Configuration.notes: Paired with Property → IConfigProperty. Config classes in core use this.

Property.reason: Individual config property. Paired with IForgeConfig.
Property.notes: Used in all ConfigMain, ConfigClient, ConfigScript, etc. files.

types.__comment_service: === SERVICE: Static utility → PlatformService/NBTIO methods (12 types) ===

StatCollector.reason: Pure static translation utility. 1.7: StatCollector, 1.12+: I18n, 1.16+: different I18n. Translation is inherently platform-specific.
StatCollector.notes: 106 imports — 3rd highest SERVICE type. High-impact abstraction.

methods.getItemById(int id): Registry lookup: ID → Item. Returns IItemStack or Object.

Item.reason: Item registry is static. Core code only uses registry lookup methods. Item subclasses (ItemArmor, ItemSword, etc.) stay in mc1710.
Item.notes: 72 imports but most are in mc1710 item classes. Only registry lookups need abstracting.

methods.getServer(): Static singleton accessor. 1.7: MinecraftServer.getServer(), 1.16+: different access.
methods.worldServerForDimension(int dim): Get world by dimension ID. Returns IWorld.

MinecraftServer.reason: Static singleton with static getServer(). Java 7 can't have static interface methods.
MinecraftServer.notes: Some methods already in PlatformService (getWorldSaveDirectory, isPhysicalClient).

EntityList.reason: Static entity registry. 1.9+ replaces with ForgeRegistries.ENTITIES.
EntityList.notes: Used in clone system and NPC spawning.

methods.instance().getSide(): Get physical side (CLIENT/SERVER). Already covered by PlatformService.isPhysicalClient().

FMLCommonHandler.reason: FML singleton for side detection. Already partially covered by PlatformService.

methods.readCompressed(InputStream): Read compressed NBT from stream. Returns INbt.

CompressedStreamTools.reason: Static NBT I/O. Already abstracted in PlatformService.readCompressedNBT/writeCompressedNBT.

CommandBase.reason: Static command utilities. Commands stay in mc1710 but some utility methods are useful in core.
CommandBase.notes: 1.13+ Brigadier replaces the entire command system. These utilities become irrelevant.

methods.isModLoaded(String modid): Check if a mod is loaded.

Loader.notes: Single useful method. Add to PlatformService.isModLoaded().

I18n.reason: Client-side I18n. Overlaps with StatCollector for server-side. Both map to PlatformService.translate().
I18n.notes: Client-specific. May stay in mc1710 client code.

methods.getWorld(int dimensionId): Get world by dimension ID. Returns IWorld.

DimensionManager.reason: Forge dimension management. Used in core for world access.

PlayerSelector.reason: Command player selector parsing. 1.13+ Brigadier handles this natively.

Side.notes: Highest-impact TRANSFORM. 800 imports (Side+SideOnly). Annotation swap eliminates both.

SideOnly.notes: Handled by Side patterns above. Import gets nuked, annotation text gets swapped.

MathHelper.notes: Pure static math. All methods have Java stdlib or ValueUtil equivalents.

EnumChatFormatting.notes: Color/formatting constants. Create a TextFormatting enum in core with same constants (RED, BLUE, BOLD, RESET, etc.). 1.16+: ChatFormatting.

EnumFacing.notes: Direction enum (UP/DOWN/NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST). Create Direction enum in core. 1.13+: already Direction.

SharedMonsterAttributes.notes: Attribute constants. Create Attributes class in core. These are IAttributeInstance references.

Constants.notes: Forge NBT type ID constants. Create NbtConstants class in core with same int values.

CommandException.notes: Exception class. Create a plain Java CommandException in core. Same constructor signature (String message, Object... args). No MC dependency needed.

ChunkCoordinates.notes: 1.7.10 position class. Maps to IPos (already exists in platform-api) or inline x/y/z.

EnumAction.notes: Item use action enum (NONE, EAT, DRINK, BLOCK, BOW). Create ItemAction enum in core.

types.__comment_suppress: === SUPPRESS: Never abstract. Code using these stays in mc1710. (352 types) ===

reasons.client: Client-only GUI, rendering, models, textures, audio, shaders, fonts
reasons.networking: Packets, buffers, network handlers, protocol classes
reasons.entity-hierarchy: Entity subclasses that extend MC Entity directly. Entity code stays in mc1710
reasons.entity-ai: AI tasks, pathfinding, navigation, data watchers
reasons.event-system: Forge/FML event classes, SubscribeEvent, EventBus, event handlers
reasons.recipe-system: CraftingManager, IRecipe, ShapedRecipes — NEVER touch (AGENTS.md rule)
reasons.nbt-subtype: Individual NBT tag types (NBTTagString, NBTTagInt, etc.) — handled through INbt getters/setters
reasons.block-internal: Block subclasses, block materials, block states — block system stays in mc1710
reasons.item-internal: Item subclasses (ItemSword, ItemBow, etc.) — item classes stay in mc1710
reasons.forge-internal: Forge/FML lifecycle, mod loading, annotations, proxies, reflection helpers
reasons.inventory: Inventory implementations, container internals — GUI/inventory stays in mc1710
reasons.world-internal: Chunks, biomes, world providers, dimension internals
reasons.scoreboard-internal: Score, criteria — too niche for core abstraction

Block.notes: IBlock exists in scripting API for block access through IWorld. Raw MC Block class stays in mc1710.

TileEntity.notes: ITileEntity exists in scripting API. Raw MC TileEntity stays in mc1710.

Slot.notes: ISlot exists in scripting API for different purpose.

IInventory.notes: 1.12+ uses IItemHandler capability. Complex to abstract.

Container.notes: IContainer exists in scripting API for different purpose.

EntityItem.notes: IEntityItem exists in platform-api for scripting. Raw MC class stays in mc1710.

ItemArmor.notes: IItemArmor exists in platform-api for scripting. Raw MC class stays in mc1710.

BlockPos.notes: IPos exists in platform-api. BlockPos is 1.8+ only (not native to 1.7.10).

Enchantment.notes: Too niche for core abstraction at 2 imports.

Blocks.notes: Block registry constants (Blocks.air, Blocks.stone). Access blocks through IBlock/IWorld.

Items.notes: Item registry constants. Access items through IItemStack.

EntityDamageSource.notes: Subclass of DamageSource. IDamageSource covers the base.

PlayerNotFoundException.notes: Subclass of CommandException. Use core CommandException.
